statement: Under the setting of Theorem 4.8, for estimation of entry (i,j) at treatment level d, E[K_MSNN(d)]/E[K_SNN(d)] = (1+o(1))*[sum_{d' in L}(p_{d'}/p_d)^(r+1)]^c.
quantifiers: fixed positive integer anchor sizes r and c
MCAR assignments satisfying both sparsity limits in Theorem 4.8
acceptance: derive the exponent vector by exact division of the two Theorem 4.8 leading terms
independent checker reproduces the symbolic identity and an exact-rational substitution
checker rejects a one-exponent mutation with nonzero exit status
paper source URL, retrieval date, SHA-256, assumptions, and quantifiers are recorded
verdict_rule: VERIFIED only if every acceptance condition passes; otherwise verifier exits nonzero
